         1                  THE SECRETARY:    Calendar Number

         2       418, by Senator Duane, Senate Print 5000B, an

         3       act to amend the Public Health Law and the

         4       Insurance Law.

         5                  ACTING PRESIDENT VALESKY:

         6       Senator Hannon.

         7                  SENATOR HANNON:    On the bill,

         8       Mr. President.

         9                  ACTING PRESIDENT VALESKY:

        10       Senator Hannon, on the bill.

        11                  SENATOR HANNON:    Mr. President,

        12       this is a proposal which would purport to

        13       limit commercial health insurance plans from

        14       creating tiers, extra tiers for prescription

        15       drug formularies.  And it would do so with

        16       language that says you can't create tiers that

        17       have higher cost-sharing or deductibles or

        18       co-insurance than now exist.

        19                  And while I frankly agree with that

        20       goal, one of the readings of this, in my mind,

        21       is that an insurance company not required to

        22       cover any specific drug -- because we don't

        23       have a formulary that's universal in this

        24       state -- might instead of be limited in what

        25       type of cost-sharing it imposes upon a holder



                      Candyco Transcription Service, Inc.
                                                         4710



         1       of the plan by simply dropping the drug

         2       altogether, thereby frustrating what we would

         3       hope to do, which is better the lot of the

         4       consumer.

         5                  And so while I'll support the goal

         6       of this, I am troubled by the way it's

         7       presented.  And thank you for your chance to

         8       explain my vote.

         9                  ACTING PRESIDENT VALESKY:    Thank

        10       you, Senator Hannon.

        11                  Senator Liz Krueger, on the bill.

        12                  SENATOR LIZ KRUEGER:    Thank you.

        13       Briefly on the bill, Mr. President.

        14                  I just wanted to say, in supporting

        15       and cosponsoring the bill, I have heard from

        16       so many New Yorkers who suffer from long-term,

        17       chronic, tragic, tragic diseases about their

        18       inability to pay for drugs, their fear that if

        19       their insurance companies are able to

        20       skyrocket the rates, are able to put limits on

        21       their ability to get these drugs, that they

        22       will literally be left home-bound, unable to
